photos.summary: Loaf 1 just out of the oven on a copper wire rack, held up — domed crust dusted with flour, sharp ear scoring visible, dark caramelized cheese leak streaming down one flank.

photos.name: img-7579
photos.summary: Both loaves on the counter together — foreground loaf large with heavy flour dusting and a dramatic dark cheese-and-jalapeño bleed along the side seam; background loaf smaller on the copper rack with similar leak pattern.

photos.name: img-7580
photos.summary: Crumb shot — loaf cut in half showing open, well-distributed crumb with bright green jalapeño chunks and golden cheese melts throughout, finished whole loaf still on copper rack in the background.
